channel.title: The Barons of AI
channel.description: Founder stories from the intelligence age. The Barons of AI is a biography podcast about the founders building artificial intelligence — the entrepreneurs, engineers, and iconoclasts turning AI research into industries. Each episode goes deep on one builder: where they came from, the decisions that mattered, and the lessons worth stealing. From DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng to Octopus Energy founder Greg Jackson — startup stories and founder biographies for anyone who wants to understand how the future gets built.

item.title: Liang Wenfeng and DeepSeek
item.description: A Founders-style biography of Liang Wenfeng, founder of DeepSeek — the Chinese AI lab whose R1 reasoning model shocked Silicon Valley and wiped $600B off Nvidia in a day. From quant trader at High-Flyer to stockpiling 10,000 GPUs before the chip ban: the DeepSeek story, the V3 training-cost breakthrough, open-source AI strategy, and four lessons on originality over imitation.

item.title: Greg Jackson and Octopus Energy
item.description: A Founders-style biography of Greg Jackson, who founded Octopus Energy in 2016 and built it into Britain's largest energy supplier — with the Kraken energy software platform spun out at an $8.65B valuation. From a childhood with the power cut off to overtaking British Gas: the founding story, the Bulb acquisition, and seven lessons on building a tech-driven energy company.
